name: refs
description: Local, read-only reference checkouts of dependency sources for agents and humans.

interface.shortDescription: Real source code for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Manage arbitrary git repositories as local, read-only reference checkouts, so agents answer questions about dependencies against real source code instead of a minified node_modules bundle or stale training knowledge. Bundles the refs skill.
defaultPrompt: Add vercel/next.js as a ref and describe its packages.
How does zod implement refinements? Read the real source from my refs.
Sync my refs and tell me what changed since yesterday.
